name: The Eclipse Observatory
core_rationale: Central floating prism-island of Continent 03 where Vesper's shattered astrolabe lenses focus starlight beams across the sky-archipelago.
local_conflict: Eclipse-moths and prism-golems have misaligned the primary starlight lenses, casting frozen twilight shadows across the tether-lanes.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Unfocused solar-eclipse rays at Apogee Lens Spire burn through unshielded gliders; the Zenith Astronomers require the Sanctum Prism-Gyro before opening the northern stair.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Astronomers say the great brass-and-quartz telescope inside the Eclipse Observatory points inward at Vesper's dreams rather than outward at the stars.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Concentric crystal lens-rings rotating slowly around a floating basalt observatory dome.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What celestial anomaly is magnified at the summit of Apogee Lens Spire?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater on Continent 03 and connects west via Orrery Bridge to Starfall Haven.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Rotating crystal lens-rings, orbiting brass planetarium walkways, and floating brass-and-quartz telescopes suspended in perpetual twilight.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Uses 13.5m starlight lens-bridges, 0.58 to 0.60m eyepiece counters, and 0.14m basalt risers for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Orthogonal 2x2 grid with Orrery Bridge [0,1], Prism Zenith [1,1], Pendulum Sanctum Dungeon [1,1, floor -1], and Apogee Lens Spire [1,0] (Fog of Lore) plus Level 37 to 45 construct/spirit/insect spawns.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Apogee Lens Spire frontier with a fog_of_lore portal and Zenith Astronomers lock rationale.
